children: The Imperial Royal Guard is one of the most recognizable units in the galaxy, thanks to their distinctive red armor and their presence at the Emperor at all public functions. Rumors about the Emperor's most loyal guards outnumber known facts. The Royal Guard is composed of an elite Stormtrooper unit, trained well beyond the standard of any other military force in the Empire.
Its exact numbers are unknown, but the Guard is never dispatched along with regular Stormtrooper or military units. It is unknown if the Royal Guardsmen are clones,
